title: An ending makes room for differences

captions.energy: Bringing an earlier form to closure

meaning: Flexible action in support of an ending is accompanied by an emotional process of combining different needs under changed conditions.
text: In this pair’s Energy Field, the Wheel of Fortune in the physical position concerns changing shared actions under new conditions. Death in energy gives a motive to end an earlier form, rather than prolong it indefinitely through habit. Temperance in emotions adds the experience of bringing differences together. Ending one way of organising a shared activity may therefore feel like more than a loss: space gradually appears for needs that previously fitted poorly alongside each other.

For example, you stop keeping one shared notebook for every plan. Instead, you use personal notes and a small common page for meetings. At first this feels unfamiliar, then it becomes easier to combine one person’s love of detail with the other’s need for a freer timetable. **The earlier form has ended, and our different rhythms have more room.** Emotional relief develops gradually as the new agreement becomes part of everyday life.

A difficulty arises if the wish to finish the old approach leads you to declare the new one harmonious too quickly. One person has already felt freedom while the other has lost a useful support. Temperance is then mistakenly turned into a demand for immediate calm. It does not remove different feelings or make every midpoint suitable. Death as motivation likewise does not mean rejecting everything from before simply to prove that change has occurred.
